notes.title: Trine 5: A Clockwork Conspiracy Update #2 (Patch v.1.0.4)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34636198/d9046943aad977cdbdb22441e73046653cf2e0a1.png[/img]

We are happy to publish Patch 1.0.4 for Trine 5: A Clockwork Conspiracy on all platforms today! 
With this patch, players on PC, Xbox and Nintendo Switch will finally be able to play together. 


Here is the full changelog:

[h2]Trine 5: A Clockwork Conspiracy Update #2 (Patch v.1.0.4)[/h2]

[b]Major Fixes / Additions:[/b]

[list]
[*] Crossplay added between all of the following platforms in public and private games: All different PC storefronts, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One and Series.
[*] Virtual keyboard enabled for consoles for password input, allowing private games to support Crossplay.
[*] Invite feature added (does not support Crossplay!).
[*] Invites enabled for all consoles, within their own console families.
[*] In Friend Only games, Steam and Epic overlay supports inviting and joining into ongoing games, as well as inviting into lobby.
[*] Gog can invite friends into Friend Only lobbies through the invite button only.
[*] AMD: Fixed flickering shadows for older than RDNA2 cards
[/list]

[b]General fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed hosted lobbies sometimes not appearing in the "Browse Games" -list when there were many ongoing games.
[*] Plugged a memory leak.
[*] Fixed a rare case where a joining player brought in an extra local player with them.
[*] Fixed local players spawning off screen in some cases.
[/list]

[b]Save system:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a case of getting stuck joining a game when player's save slots were full.
[*] Fixed Quick Join creating new saves, if player already had a save of that game.
[/list]

[b]General Gameplay:[/b]

[list]
[*] Last used character is now remembered in Classic games if players use a character not default for their player number.
[*] Fixed being unable to descend a ledge into ledgegrab if standing slightly over the edge.
[*] Improved ledgegrabbing on sloped terrain.
[*] Disallowed client having story progress locked skills unlocked, that the host doesn't yet have, if they played the same save further on their own and then join back.
[*] Fixed "Last player remaining" -effect persisting after disconnecting.
[/list]

[b]Skills:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a rare crash when controlling another Pontius' Prismatic Talisman.
[*] Fixed object lock effect persisting on Pontius' thrown sword.
[*] Fixed some upgrades being able to use incorrect player number for their function.
[*] Exploding clone no longer deals damage to the final boss through its invulnerability.
[/list]

[b]Level 4:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a sharp camera re-focus after breaking out of the Garden Party Gazebo.
[/list]

[b]Level 7:[/b]
[list]
[*] Pontius breaks laws of physics less and can no longer get out of bounds in the level.
[*] Prevented starting a fight too early by throwing boxes ahead.
[/list]

[b]Level 8:[/b]
[list]
[*] Gate Guardian nor Tower Guardian can't get stuck anymore to their flamethrower attack if Amadeus shoves a box to their face.
[/list]

[b]Level 9:[/b]
[list]
[*] One less puzzle that can be broken with Wind Burst and cause player to get stuck.
[*] Fixed broken French localizations for opening cutscene.
[/list]

[b]Level 12:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a rope target to the bottom of the elevator near the end of level, in case player falls off.
[/list]

[b]Level 15:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixes and improvements to the Sauna secret.
[/list]

[b]Level 18 and 19:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Clockwork Mages causing softlocks by falling off or spawning so that they never teleported back up.
[/list]

[b]Localizations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed overlapping texts in Nintendo Switch's localizations of Czech, German and Japanese.
[/list]

[b]Other: [/b]

[list]
[*] Xbox: Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause joining to fail on Xbox.
[*] PS5: Fixed vibration not working on DualSense controller(s).
[*] PS5: Fixed Experienced Heroes Achievement not triggering correctly.
[*] Steamdeck: Fixed and updated on-battery frame rate limit from 30 -> 60 fps.
[*] FPS limiter is now a slider instead of a text field in Steam Big Picture mode and Steam Deck.
[/list]

notes.title: Frozenbyte 15th Anniversary and Update to Shadwen!
notes.notes:

The update, called Escape from the Castle, adds 14 re-worked levels to Shadwen for free to all platforms: Windows, Linux and Mac. Don't forget to take advance of the bundle prices for example with [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/690/]Frozenbyte Collection[/url]. Its price adjusts if you already own some of the games!

notes.title: Trine 3: The Artifacts of Power update v1.11 (bug fixes)
notes.notes:
We have updated [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/319910]Trine 3: The Artifacts of Power[/url] to version 1.11. This is mostly a bug fix update following the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/319910/announcements/detail/42016940698399678]previous update that added some content and other important features[/url], but improves “The Quest for Cake” level also, and stabilizes the SteamOS, Linux, and Mac versions a bit. Changelog below and also available in the game’s files.

In addition, Steam is having the “Exploration Sale” at the moment and the games are on sale: 
[list]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/319910]Trine 3: The Artifacts of Power[/url] [b]66% off[/b]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/35720]Trine 2: Complete Story[/url] [b]85% off[/b]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/35700]Trine Enchanted Edition[/url] [b]85% off[/b]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/sub/68153/]Trinelogy[/url] (includes all three Trine games!) [b]75% off[/b]
[/list]

Here's the changelog:

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
v1.11 (build 3091) - November 26th, 2015
Bug fixes!

[b]Technical[/b]
* Fixed rare crash issues
* Fixed out of memory issues if stayed too long in the same level

[b]Optimizations[/b]
* Added rendering quality logic for OS X and Linux builds (launcher graphical settings now actually changes the looks of the game)
* Added lots of small optimizations around the engine and gameplay logic
* Optimized Zoya (Thief) grappling hook

[b]Rendering[/b]
* Fixed Russian font for OS X and Linux

[b]Online Multiplayer[/b]
* Fixed issue where boss level fire balls didn't work if FPS was too low

[b]Levels[/b]
* Tweaked "The Quest for Cake" level (lots of small gameplay issues fixed which were reported by users)

[b]Gameplay[/b]
* Tweaked Amadeus (Wizard) levitation logic (objects can now be taken as companion even when character is not on ground)
* Tweaked Zoya (Thief) grappling hook

[b]Input[/b]
* Added missing selectLevel bind into input menu (you can now configure the enter chapter bind)
* Fixed input issues on OS X when game was started (ALT+TAB / CMD+TAB issue)
* Fixed input issues with Steam on-screen keyboard

[b]Info[/b]
* All v1.11 (Steam, GOG, Humble and App Store) builds are online multiplayer compatible with this build (check the version number from game's main menu)

notes.title: Update v1.03: Bug Fixes & Linux & OS X (BETA) Fixes
notes.notes:
New update with fixes for the Linux & OS X versions (currently on BETA), some fixes for the Windows version as well. :)


[h1]Changelog[/h1]
v1.03 (build 3069) - October 26th, 2015
Bug fixes and Linux&OS X fixes!

[b]Rendering[/b]
* Fixed The Chronicles of the Guardian page turn effect which was upside down for Linux and OS X
* Fixed visible edges on glow (some of the lights' and glows' edges are visible e.g in the The Astral Academy)

[b]GUI[/b]
* Added Trineangle icon to checkpoints which have all the Trineangles collected (map level)
* Fixed save slot menu issues (correct localization)

[b]Localization[/b]
* Fixed missing Turkish characters
* Polished Finnish localization

[b]Gameplay[/b]
* Fixed issue where Amadeus (Wizard) could pick up objects with zero input

[b]Input[/b]
* Added gamepad detection on the fly for Linux and OS X
* Added Logitech Rumblepad 2 binds for OS X
* Added Xbox 360 wireless binds for OS X
* Added PS3 controller binds for OS X
* Added PS4 controller binds for OS X
* Added controller bindings for swimming up/down with Zoya (Thief) for Linux
* Fixed general issues with Steam Controller on SteamOS
* Fixed Amadeus (Wizard) object levitation issues with gamepad for Linux and OS X
* Fixed Amadeus (Wizard) object levitation issues with Steam Controller
* Fixed console (F8) arrow key issues (left/right)
* Fixed Xbox 360 gamepad "START" button for Linux
* Fixed Xbox 360 gamepad X and BACK button in "Join an Online Game" menu for Linux
* Fixed Xbox 360 gamepad default binds for OS X
* Fixed show previous hint bind for Linux

[b]Audio[/b]
* Fixed missing speeches in various levels for all languages

[b]Launcher[/b]
* Fixed launcher issues for Linux and SteamOS (launcher window is now bigger and works better on gamepads and Steam Controller)


[b]Info[/b]
* All v1.03 (Steam and DRM Free) builds are online multiplayer compatible with this build (check the version number from game's main menu)


[b]Linux & OS X known issues[/b]
* Crash: Linux: Segmentation fault when exiting the game (happens to some users)
* Rendering: When using full screen and smaller resolution than desktop resolution, black borders appears and image isn't scaled to full screen
* Rendering: Fog at the start of The Astral Academy is brightly yellow coloured
* Rendering: Water is flickering near the big watermelon in The Three Heroes - Pontius level
* Rendering: Anti-Aliasing causes subtitles to clamp together
* Rendering: Graphics glitching when underwater in Academy Outskirts
* Rendering: Subtitles with linebreaks overlap
* Rendering: Some letters are cut from the bottom
* Launcher graphic settings doesn't change all rendering settings internally for the game (game isn't that optimized as it could)
* Launcher: OS X: Cancel button doesn't actually close the launcher, the process still stays in the background (normal X close works)
* Binds: Linux: Xbox360 gamepad is not usable if you delete user binds manually
* GUI: Only upper game can be selected on "Join an online game" with gamepad

notes.title: Mac & Linux BETA released, Windows version updated!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/9ZKzRuZ.png[/img]

We've just updated the game, and the Mac and Linux BETA versions are now available for everyone to try.

Also the Windows version has been updated with lots of fixes! Check out the full list of changes below :)

********************************************************************************************************************
[b]Trine 3: The Artifacts of Power changelog[/b]
********************************************************************************************************************

[b]v1.02 (build 3060) - October 5th, 2015
Windows v1.02 patch and Linux & OS X BETA release[/b]

[b]Technical[/b]
* Fixed some rare crash issues
* Fixed memory leak issues with AI navigation mesh data

[b]Optimizations[/b]
* Batched model particles to single draw call
* Optimized AI navigation mesh data sizes

[b]Online multiplayer[/b]
* Added a failsafe logic if online multiplayer game server doesn't respond so that game wouldn't jam into "Refreshing..." window
* Fixed issue where game used Local Area Network (LAN) for online games if Steam/GOG login failed

[b]Levels[/b]
* Fixed and tweaked lots of small gameplay issues in all levels
* Fixed some broken AI navigation mesh data in various levels

[b]Player characters[/b]
* Fixed issue where crouching could cause movement stuck
* Tweaked player character skills
* Tweaked player wall jumping so that exploiting wouldn't occur
* Tweaked surface jumps from water (now instant, not delayed)

[b]Gameplay[/b]
* Fixed issue where wallhead projectiles cut Zoya's grappling hook
* Fixed issue where ALT+TAB could result missing characters
* Tweaked new level indicator in playable map scene
* Tweaked Trineangles visual deletion to be instant instead of delayed

[b]Effects[/b]
* Fixed infinite looping effects when owner object had been already deleted

[b]Input[/b]
* Added hardware cursor to be in use by default (can be changed from options.txt, InputModule::OSCursorVisible)
* Fixed cursor hide/show issues when using ALT+TAB
* Fixed cursor hide/show issues in general
* Fixed input disabling/enabling issues during cinematics
* Fixed Nvidia Shield Controller issues

[b]GUI[/b]
* Fixed duplicate data in level's checkpoint menu
* Fixed game console issues (console can be opened from F8 button)
* Fixed incorrect tooltips when using user binds
* Tweaked level's checkpoint menu (automatically scale to correct size)

[b]Save & Load[/b]
* Fixed end boss issues if player quit the game during the end boss and resumed game later on

[b]Achievements[/b]
* Fixed incorrectly awarded achievements in online multiplayer game

[b]Localization[/b]
* Added Finnish text localization!
* Fixed issue where missing localization caused game to be unplayable

[b]PhysX[/b]
* Re-builded PhysX 3.3.3 libraries to fix rare physics issues

[b]Launcher[/b]
* Fixed issues where some of the text didn't fit to launcher in various languages

[b]Public Editor[/b]
* Added "Localization package" option to MOD export so that generating/testing user translated localization packages would be easier
* Added support for enabling or disabling the playable map for MODs (check MOD export dialog)
* Fixed issue where playable map was enabled on MODs
* Fixed missing keyboard shortcut info in HELP window

[b]Info[/b]
* All v1.02 (Steam and DRM Free) builds are online multiplayer compatible with this build (check the version number from game's main menu)

[b]Linux & OS X known issues[/b]
* Rendering: When using full screen and smaller resolution than desktop resolution, black borders appears and image isn't scaled to full screen
* Rendering: Fog at the start of The Astral Academy is brightly yellow coloured
* Rendering: Water is flickering near the big watermelon in The Three Heroes - Pontius level
* Rendering: Some of the lights' and glows' edges are visible e.g in the The Astral Academy
* Rendering: Anti-Aliasing causes subtitles to clamp together
* Rendering: Graphics glitching when underwater in Academy Outskirts
* Rendering: The Chronicles of the Guardian page turn effect is upside down (fixed already internally, fix will be added to next build)
* GUI: Keyboard tooltip texts goes outside of the tooltip graphics
* Launcher graphic settings doesn't change all rendering settings internally for the game (game isn't that optimized as it could)
* Crash: Linux: Segmentation fault when exiting the game (happens to some users)
* Binds: Linux: Xbox360 gamepad is not usable is you delete user binds manually
* Binds: Linux: Xbox360 gamepad "START" button doesn't work
* Binds: Linux: Xbox360 gamepad X and Back buttons don't work on "Join an Online Game"
* Binds: Linux: Steam controller doesn't work perfectly
* Binds: Linux: Amadeus (Wizard) accurate levitation upwards with gamepad doesn't work
* Binds: Linux: Show previous hint bind doesn't work
* Launcher: Linux: Launcher's highlight for controllers is not properly visible
* Launcher: Linux SteamOS: Drop-down menus don't work properly
* Launcher: OS X: Cancel button doesn't actually close the launcher, the process still stays in the background (normal X close works)
* Binds: OS X: Xbox360 gamepad binds doesn't work by default

[b]Common known issues[/b]
* Some voice overs are still missing for various languages

notes.title: Major Content Update #7 v0.07: New Levels And Gameplay Improvements!
notes.notes:
Great news! :) Update v0.07 is now out and this time it's a major content update. Included are two new levels - the third Story Level and a new Challenge Level.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/iHfzval.jpg[/img] 

The Story level takes the players inside the mystical Astral Academy, where strange magic has taken control of inanimate objects. The Challenge Level this time is for Amadeus and it's called "A Wizard's Nightmare".

Here’s a short teaser (don’t watch if you don’t want to be spoiled in any way):

http://youtu.be/Oki2-BDd3Qo

In addition to the new content, we’ve been working on several major gameplay changes as well, namely related to checkpoints and resurrection. We’ve had feedback during Early Access saying that the combat has been too easy and we agree, so instead of just making monsters hit harder or increase their numbers, our design went back to the drawing board.

The result is that checkpoints now only store level progression, and no longer resurrect players. Instead, if one of the heroes dies, you’ll have to reach their spirit with one of the other heroes that are still alive to resurrect them. In combat this takes a longer time, so you might have to fend off enemies to save your fellow companions. This opens up a lot of new possibilities for very cool and more difficult fights.

[b]The visual effects for resurrection and the spirits are not finalized yet[/b], but we’d love to hear feedback on the new system and the added levels. :)

We've also received lots of feedback about the character outfits in the Unlimited Mode and tutorial levels when playing in co-op. We've now added different coloured outfits for the Trine Heroes to be used when more than one people is playing the same character, and we hope that this will make playing together online easier and more fun when all players are able to instantly tell their characters apart from the others based on their outfit colors.


[img]http://i.imgur.com/1Sws5Md.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/aQoKAR4.jpg[/img]


[h1]Bug Reports[/h1]

When reporting bugs, please always state the game's version number and build number. Check the version number from game's main menu. Please post bug reports to either the Steam Community Discussions or send an email to [b]support[at]frozenbyte[dot]com[/b]

Check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/319910/discussions/0/620712999989982496/]Steam Community Discussions[/url] for the full changelog. :)

Oh, and remember to check out [url=http://www.frozenbyte.com/2015/05/want-spoken-dialogue-to-your-trine-mods-act-before-may-22nd/]this blog post[/url] for a chance to get dialogue written by yourself voice-acted by the actual Trine Heroes to be used in custom levels. :)

notes.title: Early Access Patch #4 - ALL Art Assets to the Public Editor
notes.notes:
Trine 3: The Artifacts of Power has just gotten Early Access Update #4! We’ve decided to help out the modding community for Trine 3 by giving out ALL the art assets that we’ve made so far to the public editor users, and this includes everything that’s yet to be released in the actual game (even story level assets!).

We hope this will help you create even cooler new mods :)

There’s of course also been a lot all-around fixes, which you can spot from the full changelog below.

Thanks to everyone for your continued support and contribution!

[h1]Bug Reports[/h1]

Please post your bug reports to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/319910/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url].

When reporting bugs, please always state game's version number and build number. Check the version number from game's main menu. Please check [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/319910/discussions/0/620712364040419034/]this[/url] thread for more information about how to report bugs.


[h1]Changelog[/h1]

v0.04 (build 2882) - April 29th, 2015
Early Access update #4 (New editor assets + Japanese&Chinese localization + Bug fixes)

[b]Technical[/b]
* Added minor optimizations
* Fixed many crashes

[b]Online multiplayer[/b]
* Fixed some broken gameplay elements which didn't sync to all clients
* Fixed some Thief grappling hook net sync issues (still not perfect)
* Fixed some AI net sync issues
* Fixed some Wall buster boss net sync issues

[b]Gameplay[/b]
* Fixed ledge grab issues where player could end up inside the wall/floor
* Tweaked all player character skills a bit

[b]Levels[/b]
* Added more gameplay items into "Amusement Park" level
* Fixed lots of small gameplay issues in all levels
* Fixed lots of holes in geometry in all levels
* Fixed camera logic in all levels
* Moved some collectable shards in various levels

[b]AI[/b]
* Added spawning effects to some AIs
* Fixed Wall buster boss issues

[b]GUI[/b]
* Fixed missing Pontius (Knight) cursor when playing with keyboard+mouse
* Fixed bunch of issues with Configure Controls menu (added missing binds, removed invalid binds, tweaked the logic)
* Tweaked the tooltips (tooltips are more informative)

[b]Audio[/b]
* Added sound effects to Challenge Level #2
* Added lots of new sound effects to various gameplay elements
* Fixed lots of bugging sound effects
* Fixed music which disappeared sometimes randomly

[b]Public Editor[/b]
* Added ALL art assets which we have done at this point (includes art assets from upcoming story levels as well!)
* Added support for including navigation mesh files into MODs. Now the AIs will work in MODs too.
* Fixed sound effect event name auto complete feature in editor

[b]Localization[/b]
* Added Chinese (Simplified) menu translations
* Added Japanese menu translations
* Fixed some typos in various menu translations

[b]Info[/b]
* When reporting bugs, please always state game's version number and build number. Check the version number from game's main menu.

[b]List of Known Issues[/b]
* Currently 32bit Windows environment has trouble running the game (not enough memory).
* Game might be unstable. Especially 32bit executable has issues to run the game. 64bit executable can also crash after very long play sessions.
* Online Multiplayer doesn't have sound if Voice Chat is enabled. You can disable it from %appdata%/Trine3/options.txt (more info on Steam community forums)
* Older GPUs might cause graphical flickering if occlusion culling is enabled. You can disable it from %appdata%/Trine3/options.txt (more info on Steam community forums)
* Public editor cannot process convex physics objects (scaling those objects won't work in MODs). Box physics will work.
* Public editor cannot update itself. You need to delete editor_path.txt file from your game install directory. Editor needs to be installed into empty directory and your older changes will remain in the old editor folder.
* Public editor MODs will flash black when player takes damage. You can fix this by adding "ColorEffectEntity" anywhere into your custom level

NOTE: This patch is about 2GB due to the added assets.

notes.title: Early Access Patch #1
notes.notes:
Yes, the game is out and we finally have a patch! You can check the changelog below. We have also published the changelog to the game's [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/319910/discussions/0/618459931321223205/]Steam Discussions[/url], so please post your bug reports there! 


[h1]Changelog[/h1]
************************************************************
************************************************************
v0.02 (build 2865) - April 23rd, 2015
Early Access patch #1

[b]Technical[/b]
* Added some optimizations
* Fixed crash issues when using RESUME GAME
* Fixed crash issues right after loading screen
* Fixed crash in "Amusement Park" level
* Fixed few other rare crash issues

[b]Rendering[/b]
* Fixed some graphical popping (doesn't fix the major flickering issues)

[b]Gameplay[/b]
* Tweaked player walljump logic
* Tweaked Thief bow shooting logic
* Tweaked Wizard levitation logic

[b]Levels[/b]
* Added more gameplay items into "Amusement Park" level
* Fixed lots of gameplay issues in all levels

[b]Cinematics[/b]
* Tweaked and polished various in-game cutscenes (animations etc.)

[b]Audio[/b]
* Added lots of new audio effects to various levels and gameplay elements

[b]GUI[/b]
* Fixed cursor in configure controls menu
* Tweaked character info HUD fade out logic

[b]Online multiplayer[/b]
* Added text chat support (key bind: T)
* Added work around to missing audio (Voice Chat is disabled by default) (please delete file: %appdata%/Trine3/options.txt)
* Fixed some Thief grappling hook net sync issues
* Fixed some AI net sync issues
* Fixed some Wall buster boss net sync issues

[b]Localization[/b]
* Added launcher localization

[b]Info[/b]
* When reporting bugs, please always state game's version number and build number. Check the version number from game's main menu.


[b]NOTE:[/b] Currently 32bit windows have trouble running the game (not enough memory). Also 32bit game executable might be unstable.
************************************************************
